releases.notes:
- Added 11 new emojis:
  - `🐈` Cat
  - `🐈‍⬛` Black cat
  - `😿` Crying cat
  - `😻` Smiling cat with heart-eyes
  - `😽` Kissing cat
  - `😺` Grinning cat
  - `😾` Pouting cat
  - `😸` Grinning cat with smiling eyes
  - `😹` Grinning cat with tears of joy
  - `🙀` Weary cat
  - `😼` Cat with wry smile
- Fixed [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) not showing the [Client] tag to the right of the mod because Fabric was not being told it was client-side only
- Fixed resource packs being able to break Pixelmoji by overriding `assets/pixelmoji/font/pixelmoji.json` by loading it from somewhere that a resource pack cannot access
- Added `/te` as a command alias for `/testemojis`


<details>
<summary>Development Changes</summary>

- Added Mods to the development client:
  - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
  - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
  - [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
  - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
  - [Ksyxis](https://modrinth.com/mod/ksyxis)
  - [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities)
  - [GPUBooster](https://modrinth.com/mod/gputape)
  - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- Made the development client allocate RAM based on your system's available memory
- Updated Fabric Loom version:
    - `1.13.4` -> `1.17-SNAPSHOT`
</details>

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ceebug/Pixelmoji/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

- Fixed only half of these emojis' textures loading:
  - `❤️` Red heart
  - `❤️‍🩹` Mending heart
  - `❣️` Heart exclamation
  - `❤️‍🔥` Heart on fire
- Fixed these emojis loading the wrong texture file as well as only loading half of it:
  - `❤️‍🔥` Heart on fire
  - `❤️‍🩹` Mending heart
- Added a `/testemojis` command that logs every supported emoji and shows details about them when you hover over them.
- Fixed some emojis not backspacing in one go.
- Made Pixelmoji show up as a resource pack.
- Made it so resource packs cannot override the Pixelmoji font file (in theory).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ceebug/Pixelmoji/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0
